scripts.start:adaptive-fixture: fixture_dir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/saaa-adaptive-fixture.XXXXXX") && cleanup_fixture() { if [ "${SAAA_ADAPTIVE_FIXTURE_KEEP_DATA:-}" = "1" ]; then echo "Keeping adaptive fixture data: $fixture_dir"; else find "$fixture_dir" -depth -delete; fi; } && trap cleanup_fixture EXIT && echo "Adaptive fixture data: $fixture_dir" && SAAA_ADAPTIVE_FIXTURE=1 SAAA_SMOKE_MARKER_ID=adaptivefixture SAAA_SMOKE_DATA_DIR="$fixture_dir" SAAA_TOOL_SELECTION_CONFIG="$PWD/scripts/adaptive-improvement/mock-tool-selection.json" tauri dev --no-watch
scripts.build:frontend: bun run s11tnext:check && tsc && vite build
scripts.build: bun run freeze:check && bun run build:frontend && bun run ipc:check
scripts.test:frontend: bun run s11tnext:check && bun test tests
scripts.test: bun run test:frontend && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:rust-packages: cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/personal-state-core/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/larm-session/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/reasoning-contract/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path services/reasoning-mcp/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:personal-state: cargo fmt --check --manifest-path crates/personal-state-core/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path crates/personal-state-core/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/personal-state-core/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: bun run freeze:check && bun run check:personal-state && bun run size:check && bun run build:frontend && bun run quality:check && bun run ipc:check && bun run typecheck && cargo fmt --check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && bun run clippy:check && bun run test
scripts.ipc:generate: cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example export_ipc_bindings && cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example export_voice_asr_bindings
scripts.quality:check: bun scripts/conversation-quality-eval.ts check && bun run quality:runtime-contract
scripts.spec:check: bunx --bun spec-html check ./spec/docs --warnings-as-errors && bunx --bun spec-html check ./spec/docs/.archived --fixer --format
scripts.spec:fix: bunx --bun spec-html check ./spec/docs --fix --warnings-as-errors && bunx --bun spec-html check ./spec/docs/.archived --fixer --format --fix
scripts.check:local: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run check
